changes.quote: 75 to 84 month terms available for qualified customers/vehicles
changes.note: Adds the term grid the record never had: the sheet schedules term by mileage AND vehicle age, 5 bands x 4 age columns = 20 cells, transcribed in full. 84 months stays the headline — Gage: the bank does do 84, it is a case-by-case factor, not score-based. The grid is the standard schedule underneath it, and it is what a 10-year-old unit at 130,000 miles actually gets (66 months). Also adds max DTI 77-87% standard / up to 87% PLUS, which the record had nowhere.

changes.quote: Six-month comprehensive/collision policy, with $1,000 max. allowable deductible.
changes.note: The record had no insurance requirement anywhere. The deductible cap and the excluded policy types are funding stips — this is the kind of thing that bounces a package.

ambiguities.note: The bank does 84; it is a case-by-case factor, not tied to a score or tier the record could encode. The scalar stays 84 and the compare column is unchanged. The grid sits in the LTV section as the standard schedule beneath it.

ambiguities.resolved: 2026-08-26 — Gage: banks vary; some take all three books.
ambiguities.note: Program Sheet p2 lists 12 KBB states, the Funding Checklist 13 (adds AK) and says "NADA" rather than J.D. Power. Not worth chasing: Texas is in neither list, so TX books on J.D. Power clean trade either way. Kept the Program Sheet as the newer, higher-authority document.
